description: Defines the GzipSourceStream class for gzip and deflate content encoding/decoding, including state management, zlib integration, and stream processing logic.

classes.name: GzipSourceStream
classes.description: A class that applies gzip and deflate decoding to a data stream, managing zlib integration and stream states.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create a GzipSourceStream instance, returns nullptr if initialization fails.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the stream, returns true if successful.

methods.name: GetTypeAsString
methods.description: Returns the type of the stream as a string.

methods.name: FilterData
methods.description: Processes input data and produces decoded output, managing stream states.

methods.name: InsertZlibHeader
methods.description: Inserts a zlib header into the data stream as a workaround for server bugs.
